release.notes: New Inverter temp row; Ignition shows - when the car does not report its key state, instead of a false OFF; E-GMP charging rows only while plugged in; history restore accepts graph images; navigation: reworked phone map lifecycle after dialogs and permission prompts (new, please check); new or better readings for Hyundai Ioniq 5, Kia EV6/EV9/Niro EV, VW e-Up/e-Golf, Audi e-tron, Tesla Model 3/Y, Nissan Leaf/Ariya, BYD Atto 2, XPeng P7+; BMW i4 M50 DC inlet voltage and motor temperature (new, untested).
